bullets.title: Marc Pro | Recovery Tool for Sore Muscles & Pain Relief
bullets.note: I recently injured my shoulder snowboarding, and nothing seemed to stem the pain and inflammation, even after a week of recovery. [Kelly Starrett](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kelly_Starrett) ([@thereadystate](https://twitter.com/thereadystate)) of [The Ready State](https://thereadystate.com/) recommended the Marc Pro, and it reduced the swelling more than 50% after two two-hour sessions. The transformation was incredible. Of course, your mileage _will_ vary, but I plan on traveling with one such device from now on. Since I can’t help but constantly break myself, I am also watching [How to Fix a Pelvic Fault or Tweak](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Js5xg9o78Jw) for skiing-induced lower-back and SI pain. Maybe I should just grow up, but that sounds incredibly boring. My most recent interview with Kelly can be found [here](https://tim.blog/2015/03/04/the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly-of-crossfit/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf).

bullets.title: Lewis Carroll
bullets.note:
, illustrated by [Gwynedd M. Hudson](https://www.cafepress.com/ourkrazykulture/1365709). First Hodder and Stoughton limited edition 1982 reissue of 1922 first edition. Leather lettered and pictorially stamped in gilt. Marbled endpapers and twelve tipped-in plates. [Here are some pics, which also feature Molly Puppins](https://www.instagram.com/p/CaFV1lkrHRQ/).  
  
Gwynedd Hudson was a British artist and designer who created exceptional illustrations for _[Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alice%27s_Adventures_in_Wonderland)_ and _[Peter Pan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Pan)_.  
  
Inspired by [Michael Schur](https://tim.blog/2022/01/19/michael-schur/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), I decided to buy a beautiful, old book with illustrations, just for the joy of traipsing through a tactile and visual feast. I decided on this 1982 reissue of the 1922 first Hudson-illustrated edition of _Alice in Wonderland_. It cost me $175 ([here it is for $290](https://www.ebay.com/itm/201671708704)), but there are many vintage editions available for far less. There are also some beasts for $52,000+! [Browse here using different filters](https://www.abebooks.com/servlet/SearchResults?an=lewis%20carroll&cm_sp=sort-_-SRP-_-Results&ds=30&fe=on&pics=on&sortby=1&tn=alice%20in%20wonderland) to see the range.
